info.name: Freelance Marketplace API
info.description:
Backend API documentation & test collection.

**Base URL:** http://localhost:5000/api
**Auth:** `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (token obtained from POST /auth/login).

Set `base_url` and `token` in a Postman environment. See docs/API_DOCUMENTATION.md for full documentation.

request.description:
**Purpose:** API health check.
**Auth:** Public.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"message":"Freelance Marketplace API is running"}`

**Purpose:** Create a CLIENT/FREELANCER account and send a verification email.
**Auth:** Public.
**Body:** `name` (string, 2-100, req), `email` (valid email, req), `password` (8-72, upper+lower+digit, req), `role` (`CLIENT`|`FREELANCER`, default FREELANCER).
**Success:** 201 `{"success":true,"message":"Account created successfully...","data":{"user":{...}}}`
**Errors:** 400 validation · 409 email exists · 500 email failure

**Purpose:** Verify email from the emailed link.
**Auth:** Public.
**Params:** query `token` (required).
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"message":"Email verified successfully","data":{"user":{...}}}`
**Errors:** 400 `Verification token is required` · 400 `Verification link is invalid or has expired`

**Purpose:** Re-send the email-verification link.
**Auth:** Public.
**Body:** `email` (valid email, required).
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"message":"A new verification email has been sent"}`
**Errors:** 400 `Your email is already verified` · 404 `No account was found with this email` · 500 email failure

**Purpose:** Authenticate and issue a JWT (auto-saved to `{{token}}`).
**Auth:** Public (rate limited 20/15min).
**Body:** `email` (req), `password` (min 1, req).
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"message":"Login successful","data":{"user":{...},"token":"<JWT>"}}`
**Errors:** 400 validation · 401 `Invalid email or password` · 403 `Your account has been deactivated` · 403 `Please verify your email before logging in` · 429 rate limited

**Purpose:** Start password-reset flow (emails a reset link).
**Auth:** Public.
**Body:** `email` (valid email, required).
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"message":"If an account with that email exists, a password reset link has been sent."}` (same response if account doesn't exist)
**Errors:** 400 validation · 500 email failure

**Purpose:** Set a new password using a reset token.
**Auth:** Public.
**Body:** `token` (required), `password` (8-72, upper+lower+digit, required).
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"message":"Password reset successfully..."}`
**Errors:** 400 validation · 400 `Reset token is required` · 400 `Password reset link is invalid or has expired` · 500

**Purpose:** Get the authenticated user's profile.
**Auth:** Any authenticated role.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"user":{...}}}`
**Errors:** 401 auth errors · 404 `User not found`

**Purpose:** Update own profile.
**Auth:** Any authenticated role.
**Body (all optional, strict schema):** `name` (2-100), `avatar` (≤1000), `bio` (≤1000), `location` (≤150), `skills` (string[]), `hourlyRate` (number ≥ 0). Unknown fields → 400.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"message":"Profile updated successfully","data":{"user":{...}}}`
**Errors:** 400 validation · 401 · 404 `User not found`

**Purpose:** List all users (admin management).
**Auth:** ADMIN only.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"users":[...],"pagination":{"page","limit","total","totalPages"}}}`
**Errors:** 401 · 403 wrong role

**Purpose:** Activate/deactivate a user.
**Auth:** ADMIN only.
**Body:** `isActive` (boolean, required).
**Params:** path `id`.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"message":"User account deactivated","data":{"user":{...}}}`
**Errors:** 400 `You cannot change your own account status` · 400 `Admin accounts cannot be deactivated from here` · 400 validation · 401/403 · 404 `User not found`

**Purpose:** Browse/search freelancers.
**Auth:** Any authenticated role.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"freelancers":[{"name","avatar","bio","location","skills","hourlyRate","role","averageRating","reviewCount","createdAt"}],"pagination":{...}}}`
**Errors:** 401 · 500

**Purpose:** View a user's public profile.
**Auth:** Any authenticated role.
**Params:** path `id` (Mongo ObjectId).
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"user":{"name","avatar","bio","location","skills","hourlyRate","role","averageRating","reviewCount","createdAt"}}}`
**Errors:** 400 `Invalid ID format` · 401 · 404 `User not found`

**Purpose:** Reviews received by a user.
**Auth:** Any authenticated role.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"reviews":[...,"reviewer":{"name","avatar","role"},"project":{"title"}]}}`
**Errors:** 400 `Invalid ID format` · 401 · 404 `User not found`

**Purpose:** Browse open jobs (job feed).
**Auth:** 🌐 Public — no token required (despite a code comment suggesting otherwise).
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":[{...job}],"totalDocuments":n,"totalPages":n,"currentPage":n}`
**Errors:** 500

request.description:
**Purpose:** Post a new job.
**Auth:** CLIENT only.
**Body:** `title` (5-150, req), `description` (20-5000, req), `budget` (number > 0, req), `category?` (≤100), `skills?` (string[]), `budgetType?` (`FIXED`|`HOURLY`), `deadline?` (ISO datetime).
**Success:** 201 `{"success":true,"message":"Job posted successfully","data":{"job":{...}}}`
**Errors:** 400 validation · 401 · 403 non-client

**Purpose:** List the logged-in client's own jobs.
**Auth:** CLIENT only.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"jobs":[...]}}` (newest first)
**Errors:** 401 · 403

**Purpose:** List all jobs, any status.
**Auth:** ADMIN only.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"jobs":[...,"client":{"name","email","avatar"}]}}`
**Errors:** 401 · 403

**Purpose:** View job details.
**Auth:** Any authenticated role.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"job":{...,"client":{"name","avatar","location","bio"}}}}`
**Errors:** 400 `Invalid ID format` · 401 · 404 `Job not found`

**Purpose:** Update an own OPEN job.
**Auth:** CLIENT + owner.
**Body:** same fields as create, all optional.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"message":"Job updated successfully","data":{"job":{...}}}`
**Errors:** 400 validation / `Only open jobs can be edited` · 403 `Only the job owner can update this job` · 404 `Job not found`

**Purpose:** Delete an own OPEN job.
**Auth:** CLIENT + owner.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"message":"Job deleted successfully"}`
**Errors:** 400 `Only open jobs can be deleted` · 403 `Only the job owner can delete this job` · 404 `Job not found`

**Purpose:** Remove any job; if it has an associated project it is closed instead of deleted.
**Auth:** ADMIN only.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"message":"Job deleted","data":{"job":{...},"deleted":true}}`
**Errors:** 401 · 403 · 404 `Job not found`

**Purpose:** Submit a proposal to a job.
**Auth:** FREELANCER only.
**Body:** `coverLetter` (20-3000, req), `bidAmount` (number > 0, req), `estimatedDuration` (integer > 0, req).
**Success:** 201 `{"success":true,"message":"Proposal submitted successfully","data":{"proposal":{...}}}`
**Errors:** 400 `You can only apply to open jobs` / `You cannot submit a proposal to your own job` · 404 `Job not found` · 409 `You have already submitted a proposal for this job` · 401/403

**Purpose:** List proposals on the client's own job.
**Auth:** CLIENT (job owner).
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"proposals":[...,"freelancer":{"name","email","avatar","bio","skills","hourlyRate"}]}}`
**Errors:** 403 `You can only view proposals for your own jobs` · 404 `Job not found` · 401

**Purpose:** List my submitted proposals.
**Auth:** FREELANCER only.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"proposals":[...,"job":{...}]}}`
**Errors:** 401 · 403

**Purpose:** List all proposals received on my jobs.
**Auth:** CLIENT only.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"proposals":[...]}}`
**Errors:** 401 · 403

**Purpose:** View a single proposal.
**Auth:** Authenticated — only the job client or the proposal's freelancer.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"proposal":{...}}}`
**Errors:** 403 `You are not authorized to view this proposal` · 404 `Proposal not found` · 401

**Purpose:** Accept a proposal → creates project, contract, milestone and payment.
**Auth:** CLIENT (job owner).
**Success:** 201 `{"success":true,"message":"Proposal accepted...","data":{"projectId","contractId","milestoneId","paymentId","paymentReference","status":"AWAITING_PAYMENT"}}`
**Errors (returned as 500 — plain Error thrown in service):** `Proposal not found` · `You are not allowed to accept this proposal` · `This proposal is no longer available` · `This job is no longer open` · `A project already exists for this job` · also 401/403

**Purpose:** Reject a pending proposal.
**Auth:** CLIENT (job owner).
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"message":"Proposal rejected successfully","data":{"proposal":{...}}}`
**Errors:** 400 `Only pending proposals can be rejected` · 403 `You can only reject proposals for your own jobs` · 404 `Proposal not found` · 401

**Purpose:** List all projects (admin view).
**Auth:** ADMIN only.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"projects":[...,"client":{},"freelancer":{},"job":{}]}}`
**Errors:** 401 · 403

**Purpose:** List my projects (auto-filtered by role: CLIENT → own as client, FREELANCER → own as freelancer, ADMIN → all).
**Auth:** Any authenticated role.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"projects":[...]}}`
**Errors:** 401 · 500

**Purpose:** View project details.
**Auth:** Authenticated — participants only (ADMIN bypasses).
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"project":{...,"client":{},"freelancer":{},"job":{},"proposal":{}}}}`
**Errors:** 400 `Invalid ID format` · 403 `You are not authorized to view this project` · 404 `Project not found` · 401

**Purpose:** Update project title/description.
**Auth:** CLIENT (project owner).
**Body:** `title?` (3-150), `description?` (10-5000).
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"message":"Project updated successfully","data":{"project":{...}}}`
**Errors:** 400 `Only active projects can be updated` · 403 `Only the project client can update this project` · 404 `Project not found` · 401

**Purpose:** Cancel an active project (unfinished milestones → REJECTED).
**Auth:** CLIENT (project owner).
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"message":"Project cancelled successfully","data":{"project":{...}}}`
**Errors:** 400 `Only active projects can be cancelled` · 403 non-client · 404 `Project not found` · 401

**Purpose:** Complete an active project.
**Auth:** CLIENT (project owner).
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"message":"Project completed successfully","data":{"project":{...}}}`
**Errors:** 400 `Only active projects can be completed` · 400 `Project must have at least one milestone` · 400 `All milestones must be approved before completing the project` · 403 non-client · 404 `Project not found`

**Purpose:** Create a milestone on an active project.
**Auth:** CLIENT (project owner).
**Body:** `title` (3-150, req), `description` (10-2000, req), `amount` (number > 0, req), `dueDate` (ISO datetime, future, req).
**Success:** 201 `{"success":true,"message":"Milestone created successfully","data":{"milestone":{...}}}`
**Errors:** 400 `Milestones can only be created for active projects` · 400 `Milestone due date must be in the future` · 400 `Milestone amount exceeds the remaining project budget` · 403 `Only the project client can create milestones` · 404 `Project not found` · 401

**Purpose:** List a project's milestones (sorted by dueDate).
**Auth:** Authenticated — project participants.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"milestones":[...]}}`
**Errors:** 403 `You are not authorized to access this project` · 404 `Project not found` · 401

**Purpose:** View milestone details.
**Auth:** Authenticated — project participants.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"milestone":{...,"project":{}}}}`
**Errors:** 403 `You are not authorized to view this milestone` · 404 `Milestone not found` · 401

**Purpose:** Update a milestone.
**Auth:** CLIENT (project owner).
**Body:** all optional — `title?` (3-150), `description?` (10-2000), `amount?` (> 0), `dueDate?` (future ISO datetime).
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"message":"Milestone updated successfully","data":{"milestone":{...}}}`
**Errors:** 400 `Approved milestones cannot be updated` / budget & date rules · 403 `Only the project client can update milestones` · 404 `Milestone not found` · 401

**Purpose:** Delete a milestone.
**Auth:** CLIENT (project owner).
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"message":"Milestone deleted successfully"}`
**Errors:** 400 `Submitted or approved milestones cannot be deleted` · 403 `Only the project client can delete milestones` · 404 `Milestone not found` · 401

**Purpose:** Freelancer starts working on a milestone.
**Auth:** FREELANCER (assigned).
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"message":"Milestone started successfully","data":{"milestone":{...}}}`
**Errors:** 400 `This milestone cannot be started` (must be PENDING/REJECTED) · 403 `Only the assigned freelancer can start this milestone` · 404 `Milestone not found` · 401

**Purpose:** Client rejects a submitted milestone.
**Auth:** CLIENT (project owner).
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"message":"Milestone rejected successfully","data":{"milestone":{...}}}`
**Errors:** 400 `Only submitted milestones can be rejected` · 403 `Only the project client can reject milestones` · 404 `Milestone not found` · 401

**Purpose:** Full workroom view — project, contract, milestones, activity feed.
**Auth:** Authenticated — project participants.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"project":{},"contract":{},"milestones":[],"activities":[]}}`
**Errors:** 403 `You are not part of this project` · 404 `Project not found` · 401

**Purpose:** Freelancer submits milestone work for review.
**Auth:** FREELANCER (assigned).
**Body (manual validation, no Zod):** `message` (required), `attachments?` (array of `{name?,url,mimeType?,size?}`).
**Success:** 201 `{"success":true,"message":"Milestone submitted successfully"}`
**Errors:** 400 `Submission message is required` · 500 (thrown): `Milestone not found` · `Only the assigned freelancer can submit this milestone` · `This milestone cannot be submitted in its current state` · `Active contract not found` · 401

**Purpose:** Client requests revisions on a submitted milestone.
**Auth:** CLIENT (project owner).
**Body (manual validation):** `message` (required).
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"message":"Revision requested successfully"}`
**Errors:** 400 `Please explain what needs to be changed` · 500 (thrown): `Milestone not found` · `Only the client can request changes` · `Milestone is not awaiting review` · `Active submission not found` · 401

**Purpose:** Client approves the milestone → releases escrow to the freelancer wallet, marks payment RELEASED.
**Auth:** CLIENT (project owner).
**Body:** none.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"message":"Milestone approved and payment released"}`
**Errors (500 — thrown):** `Milestone not found` · `Only the client can approve this milestone` · `Milestone is not awaiting approval` · `No pending submission found` · `Funded payment not found` · `Insufficient pending wallet balance` · 401

**Purpose:** Initialize escrow funding for a milestone → returns Paystack checkout URL.
**Auth:** CLIENT (project owner).
**Body:** `milestoneId` (string, required).
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"message":"Payment initialized successfully","data":{"paymentId","reference","authorizationUrl","accessCode","amount","clientFee","totalClientCharge"}}`
**Errors:** 400 `This milestone cannot be funded` (must be PENDING/REVISION_REQUESTED) · 400 `This milestone already has an active payment` · 403 `You are not authorized to fund this milestone` · 404 `Milestone not found`/`Client not found` · 500 `Unable to initialize payment` · 401

**Purpose:** Verify a Paystack transaction after checkout and activate the milestone.
**Auth:** Any authenticated role (manual body validation, no Zod).
**Body:** `reference` (string, required).
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"message":"Payment verified successfully","data":{"payment":{"payment":{...},"transaction":{"status","reference","amount","currency","id"}}}}` (note: nested)
**Errors:** 400 `Payment amount mismatch` · 404 `Payment record not found` · 401

**Purpose:** Get (or create) my wallet.
**Auth:** Any authenticated role.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"wallet":{"_id","user","pendingBalance","availableBalance","totalEarned","totalWithdrawn","currency":"NGN","createdAt","updatedAt"}}}`
**Errors:** 401 · 500

**Purpose:** List supported banks (Paystack) for payout setup.
**Auth:** Any authenticated role.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"banks":[{"name":"...","code":"..."}]}}`
**Errors:** 401 · 500

**Purpose:** Get my saved payout account (number is masked).
**Auth:** FREELANCER only.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"account":null|{"_id","bankName","bankCode","accountName","accountNumberMasked":"••••1234","verified":true}}}`
**Errors:** 401 · 403 non-freelancer

**Purpose:** Save & verify a payout account.
**Auth:** FREELANCER only.
**Body:** `bankCode` (required), `bankName` (required), `accountNumber` (exactly 10 digits, required).
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"message":"Withdrawal account saved successfully","data":{"account":{...}}}`
**Errors:** 400 `Unable to verify this bank account. Please check the account number and bank.` / validation · 500 `Unable to set up this withdrawal account` · 401/403

**Purpose:** Request a withdrawal to my bank account.
**Auth:** FREELANCER only.
**Body:** `amount` (number > 0, required).
**Success:** 201 `{"success":true,"message":"Withdrawal initiated successfully","data":{"withdrawal":{...}}}`
**Errors:** 400 `Minimum withdrawal amount is 100` · 400 `Set up a verified withdrawal account before requesting a withdrawal` · 400 `Insufficient available balance` · 500 `Unable to initiate withdrawal. Your balance has been refunded.` · 401/403

**Purpose:** My withdrawal history.
**Auth:** FREELANCER only.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"withdrawals":[...]}}`
**Errors:** 401 · 403

**Purpose:** Receive Paystack events (charge.success, transfer.success/failed/reversed) and settle escrow/transfers.
**Auth:** HMAC signature — header `x-paystack-signature` = sha512(raw body + PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY). No JWT.
**Body:** raw Paystack event JSON.
**Success:** 200 `Payment processed successfully` (also: `Transfer event processed`, `Event received`, `Webhook already processed`, `Payment already processed`…)
**Errors:** 401 `Invalid Paystack signature` · 400 `Invalid webhook payload` / `Payment reference missing` / `Payment amount mismatch` / `Payment currency mismatch` · 500 `Webhook processing failed` (forces Paystack retry)

request.description:
**Purpose:** Leave a review for a completed project (recalculates reviewee averageRating & reviewCount).
**Auth:** Authenticated — project participants (manual validation, no Zod).
**Body:** `rating` (1-5, required), `communicationRating?`/`qualityRating?`/`deadlineRating?` (1-5), `comment?` (≤2000).
**Success:** 201 `{"success":true,"message":"Review submitted successfully","data":{...review}}`
**Errors:** 400 `Rating must be between 1 and 5` · 400 `Reviews can only be submitted for completed projects` · 403 `Only project participants can leave reviews` · 404 `Project not found` · 409 `You have already reviewed this project` · 401

**Purpose:** List reviews for a project.
**Auth:** Authenticated — project participants.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"reviews":[...,"reviewer":{"name","avatar","role"}]}}`
**Errors:** 403 `Only project participants can view these reviews` · 404 `Project not found` · 401

**Purpose:** Send a message in a project's chat.
**Auth:** Authenticated — project participants.
**Body:** `message` (1-5000, required), `attachments?` (array of `{name?,url,mimeType?,size?}`).
**Success:** 201 `{"success":true,"message":"Message sent successfully","data":{"message":{...}}}`
**Errors:** 400 validation · 403 `You are not a participant on this project` · 404 `Project not found` · 401

**Purpose:** Get the full conversation for a project (oldest first).
**Auth:** Authenticated — project participants.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"messages":[...,"sender":{"name","avatar"},"receiver":{"name","avatar"}]}}`
**Errors:** 403 · 404 `Project not found` · 401

**Purpose:** Mark all messages in the project as read.
**Auth:** Authenticated — project participants.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"message":"Messages marked as read"}`
**Errors:** 403 · 404 `Project not found` · 401

**Purpose:** Total unread message count for me.
**Auth:** Any authenticated role.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"count":5}}`
**Errors:** 401

**Purpose:** List my conversations with last message + unread count.
**Auth:** Any authenticated role.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"conversations":[{"projectId","projectTitle","participant":{"_id","name","avatar"},"lastMessage":{"message","sender","createdAt"},"unreadCount":2,"updatedAt"}]}}`
**Errors:** 401

**Purpose:** Open a dispute on a milestone.
**Auth:** Authenticated — milestone participants (manual validation, no Zod).
**Body:** `reason` (required, enum: NON_PAYMENT | POOR_QUALITY | SCOPE_DISAGREEMENT | MISSED_DEADLINE | NON_DELIVERY | FRAUD | OTHER), `description` (required, ≤5000), `evidence?` (array of `{name?,url,mimeType?}`).
**Success:** 201 `{"success":true,"message":"Dispute opened successfully"}`
**Errors:** 400 `Reason and description are required` · 500 (thrown): `Milestone not found` · `You are not part of this milestone` · `An active dispute already exists` · 401

**Purpose:** Resolve a dispute (admin decision).
**Auth:** ADMIN only.
**Body:** `decision` (required: RESOLVED_CLIENT | RESOLVED_FREELANCER | PARTIAL_RESOLUTION), `resolution` (required string).
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"message":"Dispute resolved successfully"}`
**Errors:** 400 `Invalid dispute decision` · 400 `Resolution explanation is required` · 500 (thrown): `Dispute not found` · `Dispute has already been resolved` · 401/403

**Purpose:** List all disputes (filterable).
**Auth:** ADMIN only.
**Params:** query `status`.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"disputes":[...,"project":{},"milestone":{},"openedBy":{},"against":{},"resolvedBy":{}]}}`
**Errors:** 401 · 403

**Purpose:** List disputes for a project.
**Auth:** Authenticated — participants or ADMIN.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"disputes":[...]}}`
**Errors:** 403 `You are not authorized to view these disputes` · 404 `Project not found` · 401

**Purpose:** Get my recent notifications (project activity feed).
**Auth:** Any authenticated role.
**Params:** query `limit` (default 15, 1-50).
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"notifications":[{"type","project":{"title"},"milestone":{"title"},"user":{"name"},"message","createdAt"}]}}`
**Errors:** 401 · 500

**Purpose:** Upload a profile avatar (save returned URL via PATCH /users/me).
**Auth:** Any authenticated role.
**Body:** multipart/form-data, file field `avatar` (required). Types: JPEG/PNG/WEBP/GIF, max 5MB.
**Success:** 200 `{"success":true,"message":"Avatar uploaded","data":{"url":"http://localhost:5000/uploads/avatars/<userId>-<ts>.<ext>"}}`
**Errors:** 400 `No file was uploaded` · 400 `Only JPEG, PNG, WEBP, or GIF images are allowed` · 400 `File is too large (5MB max)` · 401
